description: RS485 temperature and humidity transmitter with an SHT20 sensor, Modbus RTU
source: XY-MD02 Modbus RTU RS485 SHT20 Temperature Humidity Transmitter manual

sources.title: XY-MD02 Modbus RTU RS485 SHT20 Temperature Humidity Transmitter manual
Test report on an XY-MD02
sources.note: baud rate encoding, correction scale and stop bits

notes: Function codes 0x03, 0x04, 0x06 and 0x10. Temperature and humidity are input registers (FC04); the settings are holding registers (FC03 read, FC06 or FC10 write).
Addresses are the ones in the manual's frames: temperature is read from address 0x0001 (frame 01 04 00 01 00 01).
The baud rate register holds the rate itself in bit/s (9600 reads 9600), as in the manual's write example; the 0/1/2 codes in the manual's register table are wrong.

The temperature correction is in tenths of a degree: writing 10 raised the reading by about 1 °C. The humidity correction was not tested and is taken to work the same way. The manual's range of -10 to 10 is therefore -100 to 100 on the wire.
Factory defaults: 9600 bit/s, 8N1, address 1. The device uses 1 stop bit, but it also answers a master set to 2.
A new address or baud rate applies only after the device is powered off and on again.

Tested on an XY-MD02, firmware not shown, November 2026: temperature (including -1.8 °C, read as 0xFFEE), humidity, the address and baud rate registers, the serial settings and the temperature correction. The humidity correction was not tested.

registers.name: Temperature
registers.description: Signed value in tenths of a degree (0x0131 is 30.5 °C, 0xFF33 is -20.5 °C)

registers.name: Humidity
registers.description: Relative humidity in tenths of a percent (0x0222 is 54.6 %RH)

registers.name: Device address
registers.description: Modbus slave address, default 1. Applies after a power cycle

registers.name: Baud rate
registers.description: The rate itself, for example 9600 or 19200. Applies after a power cycle

registers.name: Temperature correction
registers.description: Added to the measured temperature, in steps of 0.1 °C

registers.name: Humidity correction
registers.description: Added to the measured humidity, in steps of 0.1 %RH
